prior_findings.reason: The only transport DialContext dials exact tcp4 loopback endpoint, reads the concrete connected socket local/remote tuple, requires a unique inverse server-side ESTABLISHED row, then requires its PID to resolve to a held live process handle still in the private Job. The transport receives no connection until all gates and ctx.Err pass. Missing/foreign/ambiguous/wrong-port/listener-only/query-error/canceled proof closes the socket before any HTTP bytes. A later listener replacement cannot retarget an already established TCP connection.
prior_findings.os_lookup: GetExtendedTcpTable AF_INET/TCP_TABLE_OWNER_PID_CONNECTIONS; bounded16MiB buffer, exactly two passive API calls, no alternate endpoint scanning or retry.
prior_findings.retry_boundary: Per-request fresh http.Transport, Proxy nil, DisableKeepAlives true, redirect refused, each allowed path consumed once. Locked Go net/http/transport.go:844-866 rejects retry on a fresh HTTP/1 connection.
prior_findings.fixture_evidence: Independent in-memory net.Conn spies passed replacement, missing, ambiguous, listener-only, wrong-client-port, lookup-error, actual-tuple and cancel/wrong-endpoint cases.

prior_findings.resource_path: Exactly one owner calls Create/Resume/Poll/ValidatePID/State/Terminate/Close. The owner consumes its own timer and stop requests, so there is no watchdog retaining a raw Job handle or tracker join. Cleanup calls Terminate, then bounded-time Poll plus non-waiting State queries until complete or deadline, then unconditionally calls Close. Native Close closes the sole non-inherited Job handle FIRST (kernel_windows.go:261-267), before ancillary handles and before owner.out/done. Hashing, log Write/Sync, io.Copy and main-side persistence cannot postpone this owner path.
prior_findings.late_action_boundary: Command reply and terminal outcome channels have capacity1. Once loop exits there is no receiver that can invoke a backend method; late stop/validate requests fail or remain unconsumed. No numeric Job handle escapes to another goroutine.
prior_findings.honesty_boundary: Terminate error, tracking gaps, total/roster mismatch, missing NEW_PROCESS evidence, unsignaled held handles, active processes, missing terminal outcome, stream gaps or overflow prevent cleanup/post-stop integrity success.
prior_findings.remaining_issue: R4-P2-001 remains: final controller cleanup/RESULT can block on a logger mutex after resource close. This is distinct from the repaired final-Job-close hazard.
prior_findings.timing_limit: Policy-bounded resource close assumes Windows native kernel APIs return; the tests do not prove Windows syscall timing or hard real-time scheduling. Poll is capped at10ms, rounded to at least1ms. A separately reviewed outer wrapper is required for the one-use runtime scope.

findings.title: Disk Write while holding log mutex can prevent terminal RESULT after stream deadline
exact_path: boundedLog.Write locks b.mu at assets_windows.go:212 and defers unlock at213, then calls synchronous b.f.Write at217 while retaining that mutex.
startLog io.Copy invokes Write and only publishes stream.done after Copy plus Sync/Close at241.
main cleanup waits for owner.out at196-201. Native Job Close already precedes that outcome. It waits for stdout/stderr done only until the shared terminal.CleanupDeadline at211-225.

At227 it calls stdout.exceeded() or stderr.exceeded() even after that deadline. exceeded takes the same b.mu at assets_windows.go:234. If the corresponding f.Write is stalled, this wait is unbounded. RESULT.json's deferred write at main_windows.go:139-145 cannot run until this cleanup defer returns.
The startup loop has/has/exceeded calls at264-268 can likewise block on a stalled logger mutex. The independent owner still consumes its own native timer and reaches final Job Close.
findings.impact: Cannot promise bounded whole-controller return or presence of RESULT. Does not restore the old blocked final Job-close path. Any missing/blocked result must remain UNKNOWN/inconclusive; no resource_ready/formal pass and no automatic replay.
findings.minimal_future_fix: Keep synchronous file I/O outside the mutex used by has/exceeded, or publish immutable/atomic counters and marker snapshots so all main reads are nonblocking. Preserve full log/drain failures as failure and preserve owner isolation; refreeze/review any author-source change.
findings.fixture_gap: TestStalledDiagnosticCannotPostponeJobClose blocks a separate goroutine that is not wired into actual boundedLog.Write/has/exceeded. It supports owner independence with a fake backend, not complete main cleanup or exact native timing.
